Save button writes sliders to config file

## Goal

AC3 of parent AH-0MT9FS3DL0084Z6V: a Save button persists the current slider values to the config file via the config module, with success/failure feedback.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Save button:** The gym UI panel renders a Save button.
- [ ] **AC2 — Persists values:** Clicking Save calls saveShipConfig(currentValues) where currentValues are the panel slider/color values; values survive reload (loadShipConfig returns them).
- [ ] **AC3 — Feedback:** A status message (e.g. "Saved") appears on success; error shows failure text.
- [ ] **AC4 — Tests:** happy-dom test clicks Save, asserts saveShipConfig persisted to localStorage key ai-hell-ship-config and a status message rendered.

## Key Files

- src/scenes/Gym.ts
- src/core/config.ts (saveShipConfig)

# Documentation: GDD §7.2 + code comments for direction-neutral ship

## Goal
Update all related documentation to reflect the direction-neutral body and per-engine flame rendering changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1 — GDD §7.2 updated:** The Game Design Document's §7.2 (Visual Style) / player ship description is updated to note the direction-neutral hexagon hull and the four-engine port layout with flame rules.
- **AC2 — Player.ts comments updated:** Code comments in `Player.ts` are updated to document:
  - The hexagon body shape and its direction-neutral property
  - The four engine ports and their positions
  - The engine firing rule (outward normal opposes thrust)
  - Per-engine flame rendering (each port's flame scaled by thrust component)
- **AC3 — EngineSelection.ts documented:** The new `engineSelection.ts` module has JSDoc comments explaining the firing rule, the engine port definitions, and the flame scale computation.

## Key Files
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — update player ship description
- `src/entities/Player.ts` — update code comments
- `src/utils/engineSelection.ts` — add module-level JSDoc (created by AH-0MTBOE8JM0040Z3Y)

## Deliverables
- Updated GDD §7.2 reflecting direction-neutral hull and engine-flame rule
- Updated Player.ts code comments
- Documented engine selection module

## Related AC
- Parent AC6 — Documentation
